title: Positive finite Cartier classes with inferred scalar endpoints
statement: Let l be prime and Y a scheme with l invertible on Y. At exponent n+1, finiteCartierClass is exactly diagonalExactFunctorExtImage(diagonalFiniteToPadic(l,n), cartierResidueReducedPro(l,n+1,diagonalImmersion(Y), its Cartier property, invertibility)). Its endpoints are inferred from that actual class. This names the positive coefficient-linear finite Cartier class without changing its object or sign.
